title: Seminaire de Geometrie Algebrique (SGA): English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-06-12 SGA repair020 French diagram repair pass
description:
Public SGA working-translation record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record keeps the current reader-facing PDFs, source-scan witnesses, and compact source ZIPs for SGA translation/reconstruction work.

Status at a glance. This is a substantial working-draft and repair record, not a globally certified complete edition or critical edition. SGA repair020 continues the SGA5 French diagram-level pass. It corrects/rebuilds diagrams on source pp.083-086 around Proposition 2.3 and §2.4-2.5, carries in the source p102 cube repair for diagram (4.4.0), and carries SGA6 French forward unchanged from the prior cumulative state. SGA5 English remains an unsynchronized carry-forward branch. SGA6 and SGA7 material should still be read with explicit working-draft/compression caveats unless a specific packet declares narrower source-checked coverage.

Filename warning. Older filenames containing words such as Complete, Strict, or Source-Checked are legacy package names and are not current global certification claims. Source-witness and aid ZIPs are locator/check layers, not textual authority by themselves.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Latest public update adds sga5_sga6_repair020_20260612.zip. SGA5 French compiled to 305 pages and applies five diagram repairs touching source pages 83, 84, 85, 86, and 102. SGA6 French is carried forward unchanged; English remains unsynchronized. This is not a certified critical edition.
